question: According to Hebrews 8:11, why will people no longer need to teach their neighbor, "Know the Lord"?
options: Because no one will want to learn
Because the priests will do all the teaching
Because the law will be removed
Because they will all know him, from the least to the greatest
explanation: Hebrews 8:11 says they will no longer teach their neighbor to know the Lord, because they will all know him, from the least of them to the greatest.
